comment: The Sun boot PROM images that wsh-sun-proms knows: name, size and SHA-256 of each, and the QEMU machine that runs it. Only hashes and names; the images are never in this repository. wsh-sun-proms refuses a file whose name or hash isn't here unless --force.

proms.name: ss5.bin
proms.description: SPARCstation 5 boot PROM (OBP 2.15): bios: ss5.bin on machine SS-5

proms.name: ss10_v2.25_rom
proms.description: SPARCstation 10 boot PROM (OBP 2.25): doesn't run on QEMU's SS-10, so no PVE profile offers it

proms.name: ss20_v2.25_rom
proms.description: SPARCstation 20 boot PROM (OBP 2.25): bios: ss20_v2.25_rom on machine SS-20 (CPU TI-SuperSparc-50, one CPU)

proms.name: lx.bin
proms.description: SPARCstation LX boot PROM (OBP 2.10): bios: lx.bin on machine LX, the only firmware it takes

proms.name: ss600mp.bin
proms.description: SPARCserver 600MP boot PROM (ROM Rev. 2.14): bios: ss600mp.bin on machine SS-600MP (256 MB or more, one CPU; pve-qemu-kvm with wsh patch 0188)
